sloka: ललाटे स महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम्।आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्तं चचाल ह ।। ६.७६.२५ ।।
transliteration: lalāṭe sa mahāvīryamaṅgadaṁ vānararṣabham।ājaghāna mahātejāḥ sa muhūrtaṁ cacāla ha ।। 6.76.25 ।।

translations.english: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.
